title: Existence and Limiting Profiles of Normalized Travelling Wave Solutions for the Pseudo-Relativistic Schrödinger Equation with Logarithmic Nonlinearity
summary: We study the existence and asymptotic behaviour of normalized solutions to the following pseudo-relativistic Schrödinger equation with logarithmic nonlinearity \[ (\sqrt{-Δ+m^2 }-m )u+i(v\cdot \nabla )u+λu = u\log|u|^2+|u|^{p-2}u, \qquad \text{in }\mathbb{R}^N, \] under the mass constraint \[ \|u\|_2^2=a, \] where $m,a>0$, $2<p\le\frac{2N}{N-1}$ with $N\ge 2$, $v\in \mathbb{R}^N$ is the travelling velocity with $|v|<1$, and $λ\in\mathbb{R}$ appears as Lagrange multiplier, as minima of the corresponding energy on the constraint.
